# MICA Digital

MICA Digital, also known as Made in Canada Digital, is an Indigenous-owned Canadian digital studio based in Ottawa, Ontario. MICA designs and develops custom websites and digital experiences for small businesses in Ottawa and across Canada.

## Core services

- Custom web design: https://micadigital.ca/t2/web-design.html
- Website redesign: https://micadigital.ca/t2/website-redesign.html
- Accessible web design and UX/HCI: https://micadigital.ca/t2/accessible-web-design.html
- Responsive web development and focused custom functionality: https://micadigital.ca/t2/web-development.html

## Business information

- Service area: Ottawa, Ottawa, Ontario, and remote projects across Canada
- Project inquiries: projects@micadigital.ca
- General contact: info@micadigital.ca
- Services: https://micadigital.ca/t2/services.html
- About: https://micadigital.ca/t2/about.html
- Contact: https://micadigital.ca/t2/contact.html

MICA does not invent client work, reviews, ratings, awards, or measured outcomes. Interface studies are original design explorations, not commissioned projects. Starting prices are listed on the services page.
